sovereign_country.strategic_role: 制造业产业链转移第一站、保税加工（EPE）设立首选

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Media Relations and Crisis Public Relations Agency

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (socialist civil law system complemented by legislative statutes and administrative regulations)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: EU–Viet Nam Investment Protection Agreement (EVIPA, signed 2019, ratified 2020)
Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP, effective for Viet Nam from 14 Jan 2019)
Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP, effective from 1 Jan 2022)
Multiple bilateral investment treaties in force with European and Asia-Pacific jurisdictions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 11/2022/QH15 dated 15 December 2022 (effective 1 March 2023); Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP dated 29 April 2023 detailing implementation of the Law on AML; Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN dated 20 June 2023 guiding AML/CFT; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 dated 17 June 2020 (effective 1 January 2021) as the basis for corporate UBO declarations and enterprise registration; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP dated 4 January 2021 on enterprise registration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or equivalent corporate existence document of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent corporate registrar of the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; where the origin state is not an Apostille Contracting State, consular legalization through the Vietnamese Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Vietnamese incorporation representative and/or law firm
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Authorized signatory of the founding shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, followed by judicial/commercial Vietnamese translation and in-country notarization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all individual ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and authorized legal representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police/immigration authority of the passport holder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy in the country of origin, then consular legalization or apostille, followed by Vietnamese sworn translation if required by the acceptance authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of business registration or tax residence certificate of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Tax or company registration authority of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization, with sworn Vietnamese translation and notarization retained in the incorporation dossier

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence under Article 10 to Article 13 of the Law on AML 2022; politically exposed person (PEP) screening prescribed under Article 11 of the Law on AML and Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN; sanctions screening against UN Security Council consolidated lists and the domestic Vietnamese sanctions and counter-terrorist financing lists; OFAC screening is additionally applied as a prudent banking practice for correspondent U.S. dollar clearing and international wire transfer compliance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (He thong Thong tin Quoc gia ve Dang ky Doanh nghiep) – https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn, operated by the Agency for Business Registration under the Ministry of Planning and Investment
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The enterprise name must be expressed in the Vietnamese alphabet. A foreign proper name may be transliterated into the Vietnamese script, and letters F, J, Z and W may be used only where necessary to preserve foreign personal names or geographic names. The legal name must include the Vietnamese company type designation 'Công ty TNHH' (or 'Công ty trách nhiệm hữu hạn') and a distinctive proper-name element. Symbols, signs, and characters other than permitted Latin-script Vietnamese letters and Arabic numerals are not allowed in the registered name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Ngân hàng or Bank – requires prior license from the State Bank of Vietnam
Chứng khoán or Securities – requires prior license from the State Securities Commission
Bảo hiểm or Insurance – requires prior license from the Ministry of Finance
Kiểm toán or Audit – requires prior approval of the Ministry of Finance
Giáo dục or Education – requires prior approval of the Ministry of Education and Training or a competent licensing authority
Y tế or Medical – requires prior approval of the Ministry of Health or provincial health authority
Báo chí or Press – requires prior approval of the Ministry of Information and Communications
Công an, Quân đội or governmental military institutions – prohibited without explicit authorization
Names identical or confusingly similar to names of already registered enterprises
Names using institutional, political or historical symbols without lawful authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, a proposed enterprise name is not separately reserved at the name-check stage; protection arises only upon receipt of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. If the Department of Planning and Investment rejects the proposed name, the applicant may correct and resubmit a revised name through the National Business Registration Portal. For an appeal on contested legal grounds, the applicant may file a written administrative complaint with the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment, and thereafter invoke the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 or bring administrative proceedings under the Law on Administrative Procedure before an administrative court. The standard planning assumption is a 30-day period for correction, resubmission or first-level administrative appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely virtual or mailing-only address is not permissible for the registered headquarters of a Vietnamese limited liability company. The registered office must be a physical address within Vietnam with a specific house number, street, ward/commune and province; the enterprise must hold a legal right to use that address. A serviced office or business center with a genuine lease agreement and a dedicated workspace can qualify, but a conventional virtual office without a physical presence is rejected by provincial business registration authorities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified likelihood for the first 12 months is approximately 10% for a low-risk, non-licensed public-relations and communications LLC. The risk may increase to 30% or higher if the registered address is shared with multiple unrelated enterprises or is flagged by the registration authority as a high-risk business-address cluster.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enterprise registration fee for new limited liability company (Lệ phí đăng ký doanh nghiệp)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment / Business Registration Office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed statutory tariff under Circular No. 47/2019/TT-BTC (100,000 Vietnam dong), converted at 23,850 VND/USD

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Fee for publication of enterprise registration content on the National Business Registration Portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: National Business Registration Portal / Agency for Business Registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory publication fee under Circular No. 47/2019/TT-BTC (approximately 50,000 Vietnam dong), converted at 23,850 VND/USD

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal (chop) manufacture and specimen declaration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Private licensed seal maker; the specimen is declared through the enterprise registration portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City for a standard circular metal seal with the registered company name

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of foreign shareholder and UBO documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of the document's origin state and/or Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular and apostille fee schedules vary by jurisdiction; benchmark includes courier and handling fees for a standard incorporation dossier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn Vietnamese translation and in-country notarization of legalized foreign documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Vietnamese translation service and notary public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per notarial translation page (approximately 250,000–400,000 VND per page)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Investment Registration Certificate and enterprise incorporation legal services by Vietnamese counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External Vietnamese law firm retained by the applicant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Stage 1 pre-incorporation due diligence, UBO profiling, name clearance, and dossier preparation for a foreign-invested LLC

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Serviced office / registered address lease – first three months
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a small serviced office in Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi; not a statutory government fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, particularly Articles 25, 27, 38-42, 47-51, 69-74, and 188-190; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 37-39; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT on enterprise registration forms and procedures.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment; operating registry: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city where the registered head office is located; online lodgment through the National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration Form No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT, together with the Company Charter, list of legal representatives, and constituent instruments of the LLC member.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum charter capital applies to a foreign-invested LLC engaged in media relations and public relations advisory under ISIC 7310. The declared charter capital must be fully contributed within 90 days from the date of Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance as required by Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14. No escrow account or bank-blocked capital requirement is imposed for this non-conditional business line.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE MEMBER / BOARD OF MEMBERS OF [FOREIGN INVESTED LLC], VIETNAM. 1. SUBSCRIPTION OF CHARTER CAPITAL: RESOLVED that the registered charter capital of the Company shall be [US$ amount], to be contributed in full by the Sole Member within 90 days of Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance in accordance with Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14. 2. ADOPTION OF CHARTER: RESOLVED that the Company Charter submitted with the application for enterprise registration is hereby adopted and ratified, and shall govern all corporate operations. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE: RESOLVED that the registered head office of the Company shall be located at [full address], with the Sole Member/Chairman authorized to sign all lease and registration documents. 4. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS: RESOLVED that [Name] is appointed Chairman of the Company, and [Name] is appointed General Director/Chief Executive Officer to perform day-to-day management, represent the Company before third parties, and execute contracts within the Company's business scope. 5. GOVERNANCE COMMITTEES: RESOLVED that the Company may establish an internal compliance committee and audit committee as needed, and shall adopt internal governance rules not inconsistent with Vietnamese law. 6. AUTHORIZATION: RESOLVED that the Chairman and General Director, acting jointly or severally as specified, are hereby authorized to submit the enterprise registration dossier, open bank accounts, obtain licenses and approvals, and execute all instruments necessary to carry out this Resolution, with full force and effect from the date of signing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Investment Registration Certificate for Foreign-Invested LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city where the head office is located; or the Management Board of the Industrial/Export Processing Zone if the office is located in such a zone; online via National Investment Information System.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For a foreign investor establishing a new LLC in Vietnam, submit an investment registration dossier to the DPI. The dossier must identify the proposed LLC structure, business scope code ISIC 7310, charter capital, investment project location, and implementation timeline. The DPI conducts appraisal and issues the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) within 15 working days of receiving a complete dossier, unless the project falls under approval jurisdiction of the Prime Minister or National Assembly. If the dossier is incomplete, the DPI issues a written request for amendment; the applicant must cure within 30 days or the application is deemed abandoned.
required_dossiers: Written investment registration request (Form A.I.1 Decree 31/2021/ND-CP)
Investor identity documents: Certificate of Incorporation, audited financial statements or evidence of financial capacity of foreign investor
Legal entity or individual identity papers of authorized representatives
Copy of passport or ID of designated legal representative in Vietnam
Project proposal describing international PR and media relations activities
Proposed registered office lease agreement or land use authorization document
Joint venture/shareholding agreement or LLC incorporation decision of the foreign investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a query stating that the dossier is invalid or incomplete, the investor may supplement and resubmit the missing documents within 30 working days. If the IRC application is denied, the investor may appeal to the provincial People's Committee under the Law on Investment or initiate administrative court proceedings within the statutory limitation period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and Approve Company Charter and Internal Governance Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Foreign investor as sole member or the Board of Members of the proposed LLC; legalization by Vietnamese notary where required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After IRC issuance, the foreign investor must prepare the Company Charter in Vietnamese language, incorporating mandatory provisions required by Article 25 of the Law on Enterprises, including corporate name, head office, business lines, charter capital, member's rights and obligations, capital contribution schedule, governance structure, legal representation rules, and dissolution procedure. The first board resolution approving the charter and appointing the chairman and general director must be executed. The full name and principal address of the legal representative must comply with Civil Code registration requirements. All documents intended for submission must be notarized or certified and, if in a foreign language, accompanied by a certified Vietnamese translation.
required_dossiers: Company Charter drafted in Vietnamese
Sole Member's Resolution or Joint Members' Agreement approving Charter
First Board Resolution on capital subscription, office adoption, and officer appointments
List of legal representatives with contact and identity details
Power of attorney if an agent lodges documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or DPI identifies defects in the charter, legal representatives, or member resolutions, the applicant must amend and re-execute such documents. There is no appeal against notarial deficiencies; corrections are made through re-execution and notarization, followed by resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit Enterprise Registration Application and Obtain Enterprise Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), Business Registration Office; online via National Business Registration Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the enterprise registration dossier via the National Business Registration Portal or directly to the DPI. The dossier must include the application form, the approved Company Charter, the list of legal representatives, copies of all member's constituent documents, the IRC, and valid personal documents of authorized signatories. The DPI issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate (equivalent to business license) within 3 working days after receiving a complete dossier. The certificate records the company's name, business lines (including ISIC 7310 advertising and public relations), legal address, charter capital, and legal representatives. Following issuance, the DPI transmits records to tax and statistics agencies.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT)
Company Charter in Vietnamese
List of legal representatives
Certified copies of the Investment Registration Certificate
Copies of legal entity documents of foreign investor and personal papers of appointed representatives
Official declaration of registered address and lease/ownership evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI requires supplementation, the applicant receives a written notice specifying deficiencies and has until the end of the statutory response period to cure. Should the DPI refuse registration on grounds of prohibited business lines, misstatement, or incomplete dossier, the applicant may file a complaint with the DPI, then with the provincial People's Committee, and ultimately seek judicial review at the provincial administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Registration, Publication, and Commencement of Corporate Acts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DPI Business Registration Office; National Business Registration Portal; public gazette publication electronic service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The LLC may create, use, and manage a company seal without prior approval, provided that the seal is placed on file with the DPI via the National Business Registration Portal. Within 30 days of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, the company must publicly notify the DPI's Business Registration Portal: registered name, head office address, legal representative, chartered capital, and business lines, as required by Article 32 of the Law on Enterprises. The company may not undertake any transaction until the legal representative has executed the charter, but corporate existence commences upon ERC issuance. The company must complete tax registration at the same time as the ERC and apply for electronic tax identification.
required_dossiers: Notice of company establishment for public disclosure
Form declaring seal specimen and seal usage management rules
Tax registration application (automatic through ERC system)
Copy of Enterprise Registration Certificate
Identity/legal representative documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice of establishment is rejected due to mismatched information, the company must update the registration data with the DPI and resubmit the publication notice. Seal registration rejections are cured by correcting the submitted seal specimen or legal representative signature list. Publication can be re-initiated electronically within the statutory deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Operational Opening: Labour, Banking, Accounting, and Physical Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Tax Department/General Department of Taxation; State Bank of Vietnam; Social Insurance Agency; Fire Prevention and Fighting Police; Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the ERC and tax code are issued, the LLC must open a corporate bank account in Vietnam within 10 days and notify the tax authority of the account number; arrange with the social insurance agency for employee registration within 30 days of first employment; set up accounting books in compliance with Vietnamese Accounting Standards; stamp contracts and employment agreements for local staff; and ensure office premises meet fire safety and occupational health requirements. For office-based PR/agency operations, no industrial production license is required. The company must display the ERC at the registered office, retain a certified copy for inspection, and maintain employment records.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Investment Registration Certificate
Corporate bank account opening application and supporting resolutions
Social insurance registration form for employees
Fire safety inspection/certification dossier for leased premises
Labour contracts and internal labour regulations
Tax registration confirmation and invoice registration application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax department delays tax code issuance or disputes account notification, the company may resubmit supporting documentation through the online tax portal and appeal to the General Department of Taxation. For labor and social insurance, late registration is cured by submitting the required declarations and paying any statutory late-payment interest. Fire safety deficiencies are remedied by implementing corrective measures and re-inspecting with the provincial Fire Police.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) and provincial Departments of Industry and Trade — not applicable to the commercial office-based PR and media-relations establishment, as no manufacturing or industrial activities are undertaken.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Enterprise Registration Certificate shall serve as the general operating instrument; no separate industrial operating license is required for ISIC 7310 advertising/public relations services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) and provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Not Subject to EIA — office-based professional services under ISIC 7310 do not trigger the mandatory EIA or environmental registration threshold under Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP. If the leased office generates only domestic wastewater and ordinary municipal solid waste, the company must comply with local environmental sanitation regulations, but no full EIA report or environmental permit is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater from office use must comply with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT for domestic wastewater if discharged to the environment; occupational indoor air quality must comply with QCVN 02:2019/BYT and workplace hygiene standards; waste management must comply with Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP for ordinary solid waste. The company must sign waste collection agreements with a licensed municipal waste service operator.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office premises require fire prevention and fighting design approval and a certificate of satisfactory fire safety conditions under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP where applicable; the lessor's valid fire safety certificate must be on file. Structural load approvals for leaseholds are not required beyond the landlord's own compliance; nonetheless, a workplace safety inspection by the provincial Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs is required for employee occupational health, especially computer-screen working conditions, emergency exits, and first-aid provisions. The company must maintain an occupational safety and health risk assessment and appoint a safety officer.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế — GDT), Ministry of Finance of Viet Nam; electronic platforms: eTax Portal (etax.gdt.gov.vn) for e-filing and e-payment, e-Invoice Portal (hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn) for invoice data clearance, and National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) for enterprise registration and automatic TIN issuance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested LLC obtains its statutory Tax Identification Number (Mã số thuế — MST) automatically upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate through the National Business Registration Portal, normally within 3 working days of submission. Immediately after establishment, the LLC must complete supplementary tax registration with the governing Tax Sub-Department (Chi cục Thuế) within 30 days, declaring the VAT calculation method (credit/deduction method or direct method), managing tax authority, bank accounts for e-tax refunds, and e-invoice registration patterns through the GDT e-Invoice Portal prior to issuing any invoices. A foreign enterprise without a permanent establishment must separately obtain a Foreign Contractor Tax registration code with the Vietnamese counterparty's tax authority before invoicing under the Foreign Contractor Tax regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — Vietnamese-resident corporate taxpayer subject to Corporate Income Tax at 20% on worldwide income, including offshore PR retainer income; non-resident shareholders are separately subject to 0.1% withholding on dividend distributions. Territorial VAT zero-rating applies only to qualifying exported PR/communication services; no pass-through or transparent status is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not provide US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections. Available statutory elections: (1) VAT method election between the credit/deduction method and the direct method on deemed revenue; the credit method is mandatory for taxpayers with annual revenue above VND 1 billion, while newly established LLCs with full accounting records may elect the credit method upon registration; (2) FCT election under Circular 04/2022/TT-BTC for foreign contractors between the direct method (deemed profit rates) and the deduction method (full CIT/VAT registration); (3) election of the 5-year CIT loss carryforward period; (4) simplified transfer-pricing documentation election for low-risk related-party service transactions under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT/GTGT) — Law on VAT No. 13/2008/QH12, as amended by Laws Nos. 31/2013/QH13, 106/2016/QH10 and 48/2024/QH15; implementing rules in Decree 209/2013/ND-CP, Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC, Decree 72/2024/ND-CP and Decree 70/2025/ND-CP.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Corporate taxpayers, including foreign-invested LLCs and foreign contractors, are mandatorily registered for VAT upon establishment with no turnover threshold exemption. For small households and individual businesses, the statutory VAT registration threshold is VND 1,000,000,000 (1 billion VND) of annual taxable turnover. Advertising, media relations and crisis PR services (ISIC 7310) were temporarily subject to an 8% reduced VAT rate under Decrees 15/2022/ND-CP, 94/2023/ND-CP and 180/2024/ND-CP through 30 June 2025, reverting to the 10% standard headline rate from 1 July 2025 under VAT Law No. 48/2024/QH15.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Viet Nam operates a post-issuance centralized data-clearance regime rather than real-time pre-approval: every seller must generate e-invoices in certified XML format, apply a certified digital signature, and transmit the XML file to the GDT e-Invoice Portal (hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn) no later than 24 hours after each invoice issuance under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP, enhanced by Decree 70/2025/ND-CP effective 1 June 2025. The GDT performs automated data-matching and timestamp indexing; buyers query invoices for input-VAT credit, and QR-code validation is mandatory for paper conversions. Certified e-invoice software must integrate with GDT APIs through approved service providers. POS e-invoices from cash registers must be transmitted immediately upon each sale. No 0% export VAT may be applied unless a compliant e-invoice bearing the 0% VAT indicator has been transmitted and confirmed by the GDT system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A VN LLC providing international media relations, crisis PR, and communication consultancy to offshore clients may zero-rate its services under Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC Article 9 only if all of the following tests are met: (1) the services are supplied under a written service contract to a foreign organization or individual; (2) the services are performed in Viet Nam but used and consumed by the foreign client outside Viet Nam, with deliverables such as press kits, media monitoring reports, crisis communication protocols and strategy documents transferred to the non-resident principal; (3) consideration is received in freely convertible foreign currency and credited to the Vietnamese bank account of the LLC via wire, ACH or SWIFT transfer; and (4) contemporaneous substantiation comprising contract, invoices, service acceptance certificates and bank remittance vouchers is retained. Services in fact consumed in Viet Nam or benefiting a resident related party of the overseas client do not qualify for 0% VAT and are taxable at 10%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Written export service contract between the VN LLC and the non-resident client evidencing offshore consumption
Commercial invoice and detailed fee schedule (retainer/ACH or wire) carrying the 0% VAT indicator
Bank payment voucher or official Inward Remittance Certificate proving receipt in convertible foreign currency
Signed service completion/acceptance certificate or deliverable transmittal statement issued by the foreign client
Proof of the counterparty's non-resident status (foreign tax registration certificate or certificate of incorporation)
Customs Export Declaration (Form HQ/2015-XK) and Bill of Lading/Air Waybill — applicable only where ancillary goods or promotional collateral accompany the exported service
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT cross-checks e-invoice XML data, customs declarations (VNACCS/VCIS), bank FX remittance records and related-party positions using data analytics to flag fictitious export zero-rating. Where a 0% export VAT claim or refund is disallowed, the taxpayer must repay the refunded or credited VAT with late-payment interest at 0.03% per day from the due date under Law on Tax Administration No. 38/2019/QH14 Article 59, as amended by Law 56/2024/QH15, plus an administrative penalty of 20% of the under-declared tax under Article 17; deliberate concealment attracts penalty multiples of 1x to 3x the evaded amount and an extended 10-year statute of limitations for assessment under Article 8. Serious or organized invoice and export fraud triggers criminal liability under Penal Code Articles 200 (tax evasion — up to 10 years for amounts exceeding VND 1 billion) and 203 (illegal invoice issuance/use — up to 20 years), and may also result in revocation of the e-invoice right, suspension of VAT refund status, and customs blacklisting of the company and its principals.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV), through its Foreign Exchange Management Department and Provincial Branches, is the sole monetary and foreign exchange authority in Viet Nam.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese dong (VND) is not freely convertible. Current-account transactions for trade in services, including cross-border PR and communication services, are generally permissible and may be cleared through licensed banks without prior licensing; however, a valid underlying contract, invoice, and tax compliance evidence must be presented. Capital-account transactions, including inward equity contributions, offshore loan drawdowns, and profit repatriation, are tightly controlled and require registration documentation such as the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), and in-letters of compliance, and often require pre-registration with the SBV under Law on Foreign Exchange. Profit remittance by a foreign-owned LLC is permissible after corporate income tax finalization, audited annual financial statements, and full settlement of tax and customs obligations; the remittance itself is executed through an authorized bank only upon submission of audited statements, auditor report, tax payment certificates, and the board/owner resolution declaring distributable profit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For a service exporter such as an overseas public relations and communications firm, all export service proceeds received from foreign clients must be transferred to a foreign-currency account held with an authorized bank in Viet Nam within the statutory time frame. Under SBV practice for service exports, the proceeds should be repatriated within 90 days from the date of invoice issuance or payment due date, unless an extended period is granted by the SBV. There is no current mandatory conversion ratio for services; export foreign currency can be retained in the foreign-currency account and converted voluntarily to VND at the prevailing interbank exchange rate through the authorized bank, or used directly to settle documented foreign-currency expenditures, provided each transaction is reported with the underlying FX transaction purpose code.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Conditional viability — Low to Medium. Offshore digital EMI platforms are not licensed by the State Bank of Vietnam and therefore cannot provide independent local clearing, VND settlement, or licensed FX conversion. They may serve only as ancillary rail for inbound/outbound cross-border wires where the underlying settlement and tax-effective trail must be supported by a fully licensed Vietnamese authorized bank. Direct crediting of VND to the EMI is prohibited; all VND clearing and corporate account core banking must be hosted by an SBV-licensed institution.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical presence requirement applies in practice: the legal representative of the Vietnam LLC, and usually at least one other authorized director or ultimate beneficial owner, must attend the bank in person for a KYC interview and original document verification at account opening. A growing number of tier-1 banks allow overseas directors to complete an eKYC video call or a notarized power of attorney to accompany documents, but fully remote account opening without any physical visit or notarized instruction is generally not permitted for a newly incorporated foreign-invested LLC. If the legal representative is outside Viet Nam, the company must appoint an in-country authorized signatory or obtain a notarized power of attorney for banking matters, and that appointee may be required to appear at a branch.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership ambiguity or nominee shareholder pattern
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full direct and indirect shareholding chain, Chinese-language and English-language notarized copies of the ERC and IRC, passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs), an organizational chart showing control, sworn declaration from the LLC on beneficial ownership, and any nominee agreement or trust deed clearly showing the true economic owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between stated business scope (public relations) and first-year projected cross-border invoicing volumes
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed 12-month business plan, executed or committed client retainers for overseas media advisory, signed master service agreements, candor on transaction profile and expected counterparty jurisdictions, references from commercial banks in the home jurisdiction, and entity financial projections consistent with industry benchmarks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk counterparty or media-client jurisdiction exposure and sanctions screening hits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client portfolio vetting report with no sanctioned or prohibited persons, OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening results for every counterparty, invoices and contracts corresponding to genuine media relations services, and a written statement confirming compliance with Vietnamese and international sanctions regimes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection source or funding origin questions for initial bank funding
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements of the shareholder(s) for at least 12 months, legalized certificate of company incorporation and financial statements of the direct foreign shareholder, tax and anti-money-laundering clearance letters from the source jurisdiction, source-of-wealth declaration, and a historical capital account statement confirmed by the LLC's accountant.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital for the Vietnam LLC must be wired to a capital escrow account opened in the exact name of the LLC at an SBV-licensed authorized bank. The wire must use the SWIFT MT103 network and be annotated with the SBV FX transaction purpose code for foreign direct investment capital contribution (typically FDI code), together with the LLC's investment certificate number and tax ID. A copy of the ERC, IRC, investment charter, board or owner resolution approving capital contribution, and the capital contribution schedule are required at the receiving bank. Upon receipt, the bank may convert the foreign currency to VND on the LLC's instruction or maintain it in a foreign-currency capital account; disbursement from the capital escrow account requires submission of the payment plan, invoices, or contractual commitments and the relevant tax registration documents, satisfying SBV tracking of FDI disbursement records.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Cross-border disbursements for the PR firm's operational outflows — overseas retainer payments to sub-contracted communication agencies, media buying, adtech platform subscriptions, research and survey fees, and software licensing — should be made by SWIFT MT103 direct transfers from the LLC's operational bank account to third-party overseas beneficiary accounts. Underlying documentary evidence, namely the valid service contract, commercial invoice, tax memorandum, and in cases of prudence the completed and signed KYC form, is lodged with the paying bank. For physical trade flows involving merchandise, corporate-branded promotional goods, or event materials, a Commercial Letter of Credit (LC) may be used with a Vietnamese issuing bank and an advising/confirming bank abroad, governed by UCP 600, but routine PR service fees are normally conducted via MT103 bank-to-bank wire rather than LC. All outbound payments must be reported under the applicable SBV FX transaction purpose code and any cross-border service payment is subject to Vietnamese withholding tax formalities (foreign contractor tax) at source before final remittance.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forward contract (deliverable) with a licensed authorized bank, based on a documented underlying current or capital transaction in foreign currency.
FX swap (currency swap between VND and foreign currency) entered with an SBV-licensed bank against a real commercial exposure.
Cross-currency interest rate swap or simple currency swap where both legs correspond to a lawful underlying debt, investment, or service flow registered or approved with the SBV.

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) entered into through an overseas licensed bank, only as a risk overlay on top of an onshore settlement account; directly placing NDFs with unauthorized offshore counterparties is not permitted for Vietnamese resident entities, and the contract must be segregated from local cash flow for accounting and tax transparency.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee (Lệ phí môn bài) declaration and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Sub-Department (Cục Thuế) under the Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 January for the current calendar year; newly registered LLCs pay within 30 days of Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; administrative fines for non-declaration under tax-administration sanctions; continued non-payment exposes the LLC to enforced tax collection and compliance rating downgrade, but does not by itself cause administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Sub-Department (Cục Thuế), General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year LLC, no later than 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines from VND 2,000,000 to VND 25,000,000 (≈ USD 85–1,060); late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; 20% penalty on any under-declared CIT; enforced collection and temporary invoice suspension for willful repeat default.
